systems.system: BIC-UEMOA (Bureau d'Information sur le Credit de l'UEMOA)
systems.owner: BCEAO with the ministry of economy and finance
systems.tiers: credit-information sharing among banks, decentralised financial systems and large billers; operational in Cote d'Ivoire since 2015

note: Credit-information bureau fed by financial institutions; not a platform exchanging data between public bodies' systems, so class other and no fact.
